_meta.note: SYNTHETIC DATA. Fictional runbooks for the fictional payments-api service.
_meta.how_to_use: Retain each runbook once as a document with its last_reviewed date. Outcomes come from incidents.json, not from this file.

runbooks.title: Tasks killed for out-of-memory
runbooks.steps: Check the ECS stopped-task reason for exit code 137. Raise the task memory one tier. Check batch and export sizes and cap or stream them.

runbooks.title: Restart tasks
runbooks.steps: Force a new deployment of the ECS service so tasks are replaced.

runbooks.title: Scale out when latency is high
runbooks.steps: Increase the ECS desired task count from 4 to 8 and watch latency.

runbooks.title: Roll back a deploy
runbooks.steps: Redeploy the previous ECS task definition revision and confirm the error rate falls.

runbooks.title: ALB target health investigation
runbooks.steps: Compare the target group health check path, timeout and thresholds against what the service can answer under load. Check recent infrastructure changes.

runbooks.title: Rotate an expired certificate
runbooks.steps: Issue a new certificate, update Secrets Manager, force a new deployment.

runbooks.title: Slow query and missing index
runbooks.steps: Find slow queries in the RDS performance insights, check the query plan, create the index concurrently.

runbooks.title: Database storage nearly full
runbooks.steps: Enable RDS storage autoscaling, archive or purge old rows from the largest tables.
